title: Benchmarking Patent Embeddings: A Multi-Task Evaluation of 22 Models Across Retrieval, Classification, and Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2605.24297v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Two questions regarding practitioners' use of patent embeddings arise: (i) Does one fine-tuning recipe suffice for all downstream applications? (ii) Is fine-tuning on one patent landscape sufficient for downstream application on other landscapes? By evaluating 22 pre-trained embedding models (ranging from 22M to 12B parameters) on three tasks -- information retrieval, classification, and clustering -- on 113,148 WIPO patents for assistive technology (46,069 citation queries) and on an external DAPFAM dataset, we find that two results cast doubt on the prevailing wisdom. translated_title: 专利嵌入基准测试：对22个模型在检索、分类与聚类任务上的多任务评估
translated_abstract: 关于从业者在实践中使用专利嵌入，会产生两个问题：（i）一种微调方案是否足以应对所有下游应用？（ii）在一个专利领域上进行微调，是否足以支持其他领域的下游应用？通过在三项任务（信息检索、分类和聚类）上评估22个预训练嵌入模型（参数规模从22M到12B），测试数据包括113,148件辅助技术领域的WIPO专利（46,069条引用查询）以及外部的DAPFAM数据集，我们发现有两项结果对主流观点提出了质疑。（i）最优微调方案取决于下游任务：横截面配准（方案R3）对检索性能的提升最大（nDCG@10提升7.1%），而组合信号方案（方案R4）更适合分类任务（F1提升7.1）和聚类任务（V-measure提升10.9）；匹配数据对照实验证实了训练数据的差异（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究对22个预训练嵌入模型（参数规模22M至12B）在专利检索、分类和聚类三大任务上进行了大规模基准测试，发现最优微调方案取决于下游任务类型——横截面配准方案最利于提升检索性能，而组合信号方案更适合分类与聚类任务。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarks 22 pre-trained embedding models (22M–12B parameters) across patent retrieval, classification, and clustering tasks, showing that the optimal fine-tuning recipe is task-dependent: cross-sectional alignment maximizes retrieval gains, while a combined-signal recipe better serves classification and clustering.
